title: PCMD 2
description: A revival of a resource pack that was made for Minecraft 1.6. Originally made by Chive_Mounds.
body:
About 6 years ago, I found a texture pack called "PokèMinecraft Mystery Dungeon 2" and since I love PMD, I downloaded the pack and put it in my modded 1.12.2 minecraft world.

I knew that it wouldn't change everything, but it didn't change the ones listed in the gallery of the pack. I was very disapointed about that, and left it disabled for 5 years.

I then found the pack again, and decided to fix it because I got into pixel art, one year of work later, it leads to now.

Originally from Chive Mounds for Minecraft 1.6 13 years ago.
(link here for proof [here](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/pokminecraft-mystery-dungeon-2/))

I present: **PokèmineCraft Mystery Dungeon 2 Fanmade v10**!

With everything from the original pack returning, as well custom additions from me!

Here is my plan for future updates
> Clean up world shown in gallery to publish

> Finish remaining textures for 1.21.1

> Remix the Minecraft OST to use Red Rescue Team soundfont

> Catch up to minecraft 1.21.11 (soon to be 26.1)

> ~~Bedrock port?~~
